name: app-black-orange-wallet-phone-beside-large-phone-back-and-wordmark
title: Wallet Card Phone beside a Large Phone Back
whatItIs: A cover with a huge black wordmark 'WAVIX' across the top, a large phone back with a triple camera at left and a phone at right showing a dark wallet screen with an orange glow, card, action buttons and contact avatars.
whatItMeans: A giant wordmark and phone back make a bold poster-like cover, and the orange glow makes the card feel alive.
techniques: Giant black wordmark cropped by the frame
Large device back as a graphic shape
Dark UI with white and orange buttons

vocabulary.definition: The rear of a phone shown as a graphic element.
A brand name set enormous across the top of a cover.
Coloured light emerging from the display.
